title: @kirigami/plugin-player options
description: Options for the `@kirigami/plugin-player` entry under `plugins:` in kirigami.yaml.

style.description: Append the default `.player` / `.playlist` styles to every sass task. Set false to write your own on top of the markup.

samples.description: Number of points in the baked waveform (also the SVG viewBox width).

cover.description: Extract the embedded MP3 cover art and publish it through the image pipeline (like ``), under `/player/`.

coverSize.description: Width and height, in pixels, of the generated square cover (cropped to fill).
